title: Take-up Rate for Digital TV Assistance Scheme
what_it_is: Take-up Rate for Digital TV Assistance Scheme

sections.label: DTV Assistance Scheme eligibility
sections.summary: The Assistance Scheme gives about 160,000 low-income households a free digital set-top box and indoor antenna, with MDA notifying eligible households in DTV-ready estates.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: The Assistance Scheme is meant to provide about 160,000 low-income households with a free digital set-top box and indoor antenna, which will allow them to use their existing television sets to receive DTV signals.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Once an estate is able to receive good indoor DTV reception, that is, they are DTV-ready, the Media Development Authority (MDA) sends notification letters to eligible households and makes available application forms for the Assistance Scheme at the community centres and social welfare offices.

sections.label: DTV survey and adoption rates
sections.summary: An MDA December 2015 survey found 62% of households knew how to receive DTV channels, and over 84,000 households were notified while close to 39,000 received assistance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: In a survey conducted by MDA in December 2015, we were encouraged to note that 62% of households knew how to receive DTV channels.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Since the launch of the DTV Assistance Scheme, over 84,000 households have been notified of their eligibility and close to 39,000, or 46% of these households, have received the assistance package.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: MDA assesses that the adoption rate of 46% for the Assistance Scheme is a good sign.

sections.label: MDA publicity before analogue shutdown
sections.summary: MDA plans more publicity before analogue broadcasting ends in 2017 and works with voluntary welfare organisations and senior activity centres to help the elderly and disabled.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: MDA plans to step up publicity in the lead-up to the cessation of analogue broadcasting at the end of 2017 and to track and encourage early adoption among households.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Apart from public communications, MDA has worked with the voluntary welfare organisations and senior activity centres to reach out to the elderly and the disabled, to assist them with the digital switchover.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: We are confident that more and more households will switch to DTV as we near the shutdown of analogue TV broadcast.
